amenityHighlights: The Finest Cuisine at Sea (Oceania's tagline)
Four specialty restaurants included in every fare

cabinCategories.description: Veranda stateroom — Oceania Riviera's entry category features gorgeous teak verandas, Tranquility Beds, and the finest cuisine at sea included in every sailing.
Concierge Level Veranda stateroom — enhanced amenities, priority embarkation, upgraded welcome amenities, and access to the Concierge Lounge.
Penthouse Suite with butler service, Bulgari bath amenities, and access to the exclusive Privée private dining room. The finest non-world-cruise Alaska suite available.

diningOptions: Grand Dining Room — all included, no reservation surcharges
exclusions: Shore excursions (Simply More packages include credit)
inclusions: All meals in all four specialty restaurants and Grand Dining Room — no surcharges ever

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Oceania Riviera — the finest food at sea — begins a 10-night Alaska voyage for the discerning traveler.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A relaxed day at sea on Oceania's intimate 1,250-guest Riviera. The culinary program and warm service are immediately evident from day one.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Coastal Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's remarkable capital with extra time to truly explore. A helicopter glacier tour followed by whale watching is entirely feasible with Riviera's generous port schedule.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: The White Pass Railway, the legendary Chilkoot Trail history, and the perfectly preserved Gold Rush downtown make Skagway an essential Alaska experience.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through Glacier Bay's UNESCO World Heritage wilderness. On a smaller ship like Riviera, the experience feels more intimate and immersive.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Russian Alaska, Tlingit heritage, and extraordinary sea life converge in Sitka. Castle Hill, St. Michael's Cathedral, and the Alaska Raptor Center are highlights.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street, totem pole parks, and outstanding fresh Dungeness crab — Ketchikan is a culinary and cultural highlight of any Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An off-the-beaten-path gem rich in First Nations culture and remarkable wildlife. One of Southeast Alaska's least-visited and most rewarding ports.
portsOfCall.name: Prince Rupert, BC

portsOfCall.description: A final stunning scenic day through the protected waters of the Inside Passage — watch for humpback whales, orcas, and bald eagles.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: A refined finale in British Columbia's elegant capital. Butchart Gardens or afternoon tea at the Empress perfectly caps an Oceania Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

portsOfCall.description: Return to Seattle — disembarkation day after a memorable 10-night Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

reviewSnippet: Oceania is known for its cuisine — Jacques and Red Ginger are highlights — on a mid-size ship with longer itineraries; best for food-focused travelers who prefer a quieter, adult atmosphere.

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 for Riviera's first 2027 Alaska voyage.

portsOfCall.name: Wrangell, AK

portsOfCall.description: Totem park on Prince of Wales Island.
portsOfCall.name: Klawock, AK

portsOfCall.description: Board Riviera in Vancouver for 11 nights through the Inside Passage, ending in Seattle. Seattle tip: get to Vancouver by one-way rental car (several agencies take returns near Canada Place), Amtrak Cascades or bus — bring your passport — then sail home and ride straight back from the pier.
portsOfCall.name: Vancouver, BC

portsOfCall.description: Disembark in Seattle — you're home. Rideshare or light rail from the pier.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA
